text_original: Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Physical buttons/knobs for climate control — unknown: Not stated in fetched CN sources. Notes: G68 shares the G60 dashboard (12.3" + 14.9" curved display); BMW's US release says G60 climate is touch-operated on the control display (E0024). Not verified for G68.

Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Automated / remote parking — standard: Parking Assistant Pro newly standard: smartphone remote parking and 200 m reversing assistant. Notes: Autohome creator (self-media) launch article, 2026-02-03, on the 2026 5 Series / i5 launch of 2 Feb 2026. Big contrast to DE, where remote parking (5DW) is an extra-cost option needing Travel Paket. CarNewsChina i5 params: automatic parking yes, parking memory yes.

Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Ventilated front seats — standard: Front seat ventilation standard (with two-tone comfort seats). Notes: Self-media launch article. In DE ventilation needs the EUR 2,750 Comfort Paket; in US the $1,350 Luxury Seating Package. Exact excerpt from https://chejiahao.autohome.com.cn/info/24819297 (fetched 2026-10-10T16:19:23Z, whitespace normalised): «时标配双拼色舒适座椅、前排座椅通风、后排座椅加热、四区自动空调及 5G 网络，配»

Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Rear seat comfort (heated/ventilated/recline/rear screens/controls) — standard: Rear seat heating and 4-zone automatic climate standard; rear screens / rear ventilation / rear massage not listed. Notes: Long wheelbase (+110 mm) is the main rear-comfort lever. CarNewsChina 2026 i5 params: rear seat heating and 4-zone AC on all three variants. Top trims add unspecified rear comfort items.
